name: agent-factory
description: Two Agent Factory skills for managed agent execution and shared project conventions.

interface.shortDescription: Run managed agents with shared project conventions.
interface.longDescription: Provides two public Skills: Agent for the Main -> Work -> Verification graph and Convention for shared rules, authority, and core semantics. Explorer and Interview remain Convention-owned capabilities applied by Work and Main. Document, Gather, Tool, and Workspace are domains of the selected authenticated Agent Factory MCP application rather than plugin Skills. The MCP application owns Document persistence and search, connections and collection, shared reporting, and Workspace runtime assets. Local exec/loop and minimum support retain session, run, graph, and receipt authority.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent to orchestrate the next request through the appropriate managed role.
